## Invitations

A total of 2279 invitations were issued during the reporting period. Attendance was 596, representing a rate of 26.2 per cent. These figures provide the recorded position for invitations issued and attendance received.

The attendance result is reported alongside the invitation total to support a clear review of outreach activity. No further interpretation of the figures is included in this report.

## Contact

SMS contact was used for 1960 invitees. Reminders were sent to 1775. These contact figures are presented separately from the invitation and attendance figures to show the recorded use of text messaging and reminders.

The information provides a concise record of the outreach contacts made and the response received. It may be used to support routine review of contact activity and attendance.

Prepared by G. Evans.
